title: Technological evolution of constructed wetlands: a big data patent analysis
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00372E, Paper
Qian Cheng, Bo Wang, Tianlong Hua, Haotian Xue, Jingyi Zhao, Penghui Li
